summary: authn-context missing 'cert_role' claim prevents scheduled batch worker service-account swap in private
description: Issue summary: After an IdP metadata refresh in the customer's private VPC deployment, scheduled batch inference workers are failing to swap to ephemeral service accounts used for long-running batched jobs. Impact: Horizon Analytics' nightly bulk inference jobs (scheduled via their internal scheduler) are stalling with 403 authz errors and getting retried; this is impacting SLAs for their nightly reports. Environment: Private deployment in us-east-1 (customer-managed control plane). Affected path: token exchange flow used by the scheduled worker process (service account JWT -> Redwood ephemeral service-account). Observed behavior: Token exchange completes, but the resulting assertion presented to the admin API lacks the cert_role claim required by RBAC policy, leading to a deny. Expected behavior: After token exchange, the assertion should include cert_role and tenant bindings so scheduled workers can impersonate ephemeral service accounts and run batch jobs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer runs a scheduled batch job in their private deployment that triggers a service-account JWT swap against the admin token-swap endpoint.
2) Identity proxy performs token exchange with configured external IdP and returns ephemeral assertion to scheduler worker.
3) Worker attempts to call Redwood admin-impersonation endpoint with assertion; request receives 403 due to missing cert_role claim.
4) Re-running the job after restarting the identity-proxy sometimes restores claims (intermittent).
logs: 2026-03-12T02:14:03Z identity-proxy INFO received token-swap request from scheduler-worker-42
2026-03-12T02:14:03Z identity-proxy DEBUG mapped claims -> {sub: 'svc-worker-42', aud: 'redwood-admin', tenant: 'horizon', exp: 1678626003}
2026-03-12T02:14:03Z admin-api WARN authorization failed for request id 7f9c: missing required claim 'cert_role'
2026-03-12T02:14:03Z scheduler ERROR batch-job-20260312-37 failed: 403 Forbidden (missing cert_role)
observed_behavior: Scheduled batch worker calls to admin-impersonation endpoint are rejected with 403 because the assertion returned from the IdP exchange path does not include cert_role. This started after an automated IdP metadata refresh (customer reports on 2026-03-11 23:50 local). The problem is intermittent: in some cases a restart of identity-proxy returns cert_role again for subsequent exchanges.
expected_behavior: All token-exchange flows for scheduled workers should preserve/translate the cert_role claim (or an equivalent mapped attribute) so RBAC policies that rely on cert_role succeed and batch jobs can proceed without manual restarts.
investigation_notes: • Customer confirmed they did not change RBAC policies or service account templates prior to the first failure.
• Identity-proxy request/response traces show the raw assertion from IdP does contain a 'roles' array but not the expected 'cert_role' key after metadata refresh.

• Hypothesis: recent IdP metadata rotation changed the attribute mapping (NameFormat or attribute alias). Our claim-mapper defaults to 'cert_role' and falls back to scanning 'roles' only when explicit mapping exists—this can cause the claim name to be omitted.

• Reproduced in staging by forcing IdP metadata swap and running same token-swap flow: confirmed that NameFormat differences result in mapper skipping claim population (issue present in identity-proxy v1.8.3).
• Related: SUP-421999 has a similar claim-ordering symptom; linking for context.
workaround: Temporary workaround implemented: In the customer's ingress/identity-proxy configuration we enabled 'claim_passthrough: true' to copy raw IdP attributes through to the assertion without strict mapping. This allowed scheduled jobs to proceed for now. Workaround requires a config reload and is not persisted across identity-proxy restarts unless they keep the flag set.
next_steps: 1) Patch identity-proxy claim-mapper to treat 'roles' array as equivalent to 'cert_role' when a mapped claim is not present (backport to stable v1.8.x).
2) Add integration test to cover NameFormat variations and attribute aliasing.
3) Coordinate with customer to validate patch in their private deployment during a maintenance window (provide patch and runbook).
4) Consider adding a telemetry alert when claim-mapper results in empty critical claims for admin-impersonation flows.
comments: Support (2026-03-12) - Maya Chen: Customer reported nightly bulk jobs failing with 403 after IdP metadata refresh. Provided initial logs and confirmed private deployment.

Customer (2026-03-12) - Horizon SRE (Samir Kaur): We rotated IdP metadata as part of routine cert renewal at 2026-03-11T23:50. We saw the first failed job shortly after. We can keep claim_passthrough=true for now if that helps.

Support (2026-03-12) - Maya Chen: Enabled claim_passthrough=true in customer's identity-proxy config and restarted the process. Observed subsequent token-exchanges include raw 'roles' and jobs resumed. Marking as workaround.

SRE (2026-03-13) - Liam O'Connor: Reproduced issue in staging. Filed a PR to treat 'roles' as alias for 'cert_role' and added unit tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/identity-proxy/pull/452
Eng (2026-03-14) - Priya Rao: Will schedule backport to v1.8.x and coordinate with Release Ops. Patch includes an opt-out flag 'strict_claim_names' for customers who require strict mapping.
Customer (2026-03-14) - Samir Kaur: We're available for a 02:00 UTC maintenance window Friday to accept the patch and test.
resolution: In Progress - workaround applied (claim_passthrough=true). Engineering patch authored and awaiting backport/QA before deployment to customer's private control plane. Follow-up: schedule maintenance window with customer to apply v1.8.x backport.
